messages.author: 72e4282de38a4e8f
messages.subject: compare.evol.rates different results
parts:
Hi all, 

I recently updated my geomorph version for the 4.0.7
I was running the vignette to obtain evol rates with Plethodon data, and noticed that significance assessment is throwing different results from previous version and those of the vignettes. 

Observed ratio and rate for group are the same but significance now is:
simulation: ER$P.value [1] 0.124
permutation: > ER$P.value [1] 0.394

should I update any other package?

Thank you in advance.

Dean
